How do we reimburse drivers who charge at home?
The driver’s charger reports each session. You get the kWh per driver and reimburse at the rate you agree. In some countries, Germany for example, reimbursement must be by the exact kWh.
Do all vehicles need to be the same make?
No. VOOL charges any electric vehicle with a Type 2 connection.

Send the number of vehicles, their return and departure times and the main fuse size.
